description: ADO-CONN/ADO-PROPS: on a fresh Connection read State, Provider, ConnectionString, Mode, CursorLocation, timeouts, Version, Attributes, IsolationLevel and the full Properties inventory (Name, Type, Value, Attributes); set Provider = ACE and inventory again; set Properties("Data Source") to the fixture path through a retained Property wrapper and Mode = adModeRead; Open; read the same state and inventory; read the retained Data Source wrapper; Close; read state, the wrapper, Properties.Count and inventory once more. Asks which properties exist and what they hold in each state.
retentionNote: Designed r-str-ado-act probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
